articles.title: How proprietary formats have become Microsoft’s main tool for lock-in
articles.originalTitle: How proprietary formats have become Microsoft’s main tool for lock-in
articles.excerpt: In the previous article, we explored the importance of standards: how the unspoken agreements governing electrical sockets, paper sizes and file formats form the foundations of a world in which choices remain open and power is not concentrated in the hands of a single player.
